rationale: C01 is the clear material template: it created the very Interdepartmental Committee on Narcotics addressed by the child and defined its work in terms closely reflected in the requested survey. The child converts C01's standing duties—collecting information about Federal, State, and local enforcement, studying addiction and rehabilitation, and addressing national and international narcotics programs—into a concrete reporting assignment. C03 has a secondary structural resemblance as a letter directing an interagency committee to conduct a comprehensive survey, coordinate with State and local agencies, and produce a report. C13 is weaker but shares committee-based federal coordination, Federal-State cooperation, and reporting machinery.

shared_material.child_excerpt: a comprehensive up-to-date survey on the extent of narcotic addiction is urgently needed and should be made by the Committee
shared_material.parent_excerpt: To maintain information regarding the character and effects of narcotic drugs and marihuana and the nature and results of drug addiction.
shared_material.explanation: The child turns the committee's existing information-gathering duty concerning addiction into a specific comprehensive survey.

shared_material.child_excerpt: A determination of what the States and local agencies have accomplished and what they are equipped to do in the field of law enforcement
shared_material.parent_excerpt: To maintain information regarding Federal, State, and local law-enforcement action taken in connection with the illegal sale and use of narcotic drugs and marihuana
shared_material.explanation: Both assign the same committee to examine narcotics enforcement at Federal, State, and local levels.

shared_material.child_excerpt: and in the rehabilitation of the victims of the scourge
shared_material.parent_excerpt: To examine and study the problems of prevention and control of drug addiction and habituation and of the treatment and rehabilitation of addicts
shared_material.explanation: The rehabilitation component closely tracks a specifically enumerated committee function.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Receipt of the Committee's report on both subjects as promptly as possible will expedite systematic review and improvement of our narcotics programs--local, national and international.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: To examine and study problems and developments arising in the administration and enforcement, national and international, of the laws and conventions relating to narcotic drugs and marihuana.
shared_material.explanation: The child preserves the earlier directive's multi-level and international scope while requesting a report for program improvement.
